scope: Metadata-only linkage of accepted November 3 supporting components and source diagnostics to pending source statements; no numbered source-statement promotion.
evidence_policy: The first 100 components retain their inherited published evidence. The seven new components passed their fixed gates and focused aggregate before linkage; their acceptance record is written with the reconciled register hash in the same checkpoint. No full-root, clean-room or CI rerun is claimed.
interpretation: Component and fixed-target totals measure checked supporting results and diagnostics, not a percentage of completed source statements or remaining mathematical work.
